scope: Independent matched measured-SLAM navigation and physical route audit of Teacher outer PID and CHAMP; simulation only. Historical camera Demo and previous short routes provide no result for this campaign.
stage_gate: One new diagnostic per controller/case may expose failure. Three repetitions with one frozen version are required for campaign passage; keep every failed diagnostic and never pool prior scopes.

localization.anchor: One immutable initial accepted raw SLAM position and yaw; predefined relative fixture geometry only. No simulator pose/yaw used to update goals, PID, navigation region or planner.

arrival.deadline_scope: From actual per-goal activation; sensor holds and replans consume the same deadline.

transport.ttl_physical_claim: Requires new moving-to-expired event and complete settling+parking window. Brief holds or standing alone remain unverified.

physical.native_truth_use: Independent post-run pose/COM velocity/contact/clearance/joint/torque evaluation only.

route.truth_alignment: One frozen SE3 at raw SLAM anchor only; causal native state <= stamp, maximum match gap .005001. Report independent SLAM error; never feed this alignment to runtime.

parking.Teacher_policy: Every frame actor inferred with zero velocity command, never action=0 or captured support pose.
parking.window: First actual navigation succeeded status ROS clock +3s, fixed following5s. The corresponding original rawSLAM region end is independently verified; never select a later favorable window.

contact.load_statement: Actual top-face contact support proxy. Raw wrenches are not validated vertical load measurements.

fair_comparison.Teacher_scan: Explicit frozen selected collision targets, source and source SHA. Teacher may retain privileged actor inputs; neither controller may use truth for navigation.
fair_comparison.CHAMP_status: unverified until an actual new run satisfies this protocol; successful camera Demo is not evidence.
fair_comparison.actuator_difference: CHAMP legacy effortPID/initialjointpose versus Teacher PD25/.5+DCmotor. Same force23.5 and physicaljointvelocity30 safety bounds required; no claim that the motor models are equivalent.

continuous_stage_gate: Only after all four original-width single-ramp directions and flat roundtrip have3/3passes for the chosen controller. The continuous route is a separate unverified test until actually executed.
